about.title: About us
about.intro: An accredited healthy-wilayat project that creates an environment supporting health and sustainable development, by empowering the local community and building integrated partnerships between the government, civil and private sectors in Wilayat Seeb.
about.vision: A comprehensive community development movement that aims to make Wilayat Seeb a national and regional model of a sustainable healthy city, built on social justice, healthy urban planning and active partnership between all sectors, reflecting the core pillars of Oman Vision 2040.
about.mission: Health is more than the absence of disease, and 80% of what determines our health is shaped outside the Ministry of Health and traditional healthcare. That is why Healthy Seeb follows a “Health in All Policies” approach: we bring different sectors together to improve public health, support sustainable urban growth and build an active community partnership that ensures a healthy, fair environment for everyone in the wilayat.
